entries.title: A quenched local limit theorem for stochastic flows
entries.read_scope: Actual HTML model, Theorem1.1, introduction after theorem, §1.1 proof strategy, completion of proof, and references. Not a complete line-by-line proof audit.
entries.comparison: Continuum Gaussian-velocity flow with molecular Brownian noise; quantitative L2 Gaussian-times-stationary-corrector limit. Classical final-time-layer decomposition is explicit. Neither the model nor the stated estimate is the fixed-law all-diverging-interval superpolynomial environmental-tail claim.

entries.title: Random walks in space-time random media in all spatial dimensions: the full subcritical fluctuation regime
entries.read_scope: Selected actual HTML passages in §§1.1–1.4, including assumptions/definitions/model examples, full Theorem1.13 and adjacent comparison/remarks; §§1.8 and selected bibliography. Not all 100-plus pages or all technical proofs.
entries.comparison: General iid-time kernels with short-range spatial correlations and a negative-regularity fluctuation-field limit in d=1. Contains broad relevant mechanisms. No all-shrinking-cell coarse-L1 superpolynomial tail conclusion was identified in the inspected statements.

entries.title: Random walk on nonnegative integers in beta distributed random environment
entries.read_scope: Actual §§1.3–1.4, Proposition1.13 full-space comparison, §4.5 coalescing argument, AppendixB statement/formula and asymptotic argument. No full-paper mathematical validation.
entries.comparison: Full-space beta special case has a Gamma-corrected one-point local limit; half-space result has boundary parameters. Late-time decomposition and ordered coalescence are explicit antecedents. These are not the claimed environmental-tail theorem for arbitrary iid elliptic laws.

entries.title: Random-walk in Beta-distributed random environment
entries.read_scope: Actual model and introduction central-limit/overlap discussion, theorem headings and bibliography; author journal PDF first-page metadata. Correction DOI10.1007/s00440-022-01122-3 was discovered but not full-read.
entries.comparison: Exactly solvable beta RWRE and large-deviation fluctuations; its central-limit discussion credits earlier invariance principles. Special integrable law and different asymptotic observable do not establish the candidate's full quantifiers.

entries.authors: Mathew Joseph; Firas Rassoul-Agha; Timo Seppalainen
entries.title: Independent Particles in a Dynamical Random Environment
entries.read_scope: Actual author full-PDF text at model/assumptions, Theorems1.1–1.2 and Corollary1.3, difference-kernel definitions and references. No full proof rereview.
entries.comparison: Equilibrium particle measures, stationary-density correlations, and fluctuation results provide direct prior context. The inspected principal statements do not assert all-diverging-cell superpolynomial environmental-tail concentration. Aperiodicity must be checked, not silently copied.

entries.authors: Marton Balazs; Firas Rassoul-Agha; Timo Seppalainen
entries.title: The random average process and random walk in a space-time random environment in one dimension
entries.read_scope: Actual full-PDF text of §3 model, Theorem3.1, adjacent quenched-mean fluctuation statements, difference-walk references. Not a full proof rereview.
entries.comparison: Known quenched invariance principle and n^(1/4) mean-fluctuation scale; these do not alone imply small-block total variation or a superpolynomial environment tail. Replica/difference-chain methods deserve credit.

entries.title: Differing averaged and quenched large deviations for random walks in random environments in dimensions two and three
entries.read_scope: Actual PDF introduction pp1–4, model assumptions and Theorem1.5; no full technical-proof audit.
entries.comparison: Uniformly elliptic space-time model; ballistic large-deviation rate functions differ away from typical velocity. This is compatible with fixed-epsilon coarse-L1 closeness near the bulk and is not an anticipation or contradiction of the candidate.

entries.title: Quenched local central limit theorem for random walks in a time-dependent balanced random environment
entries.read_scope: Actual publisher model, invariant-density theorem and local-limit statement; not a full proof read.
entries.comparison: Continuous-time, balanced, uniformly elliptic setting in d>=2 and invariant-density normalization. It cannot simply be substituted for a discrete-time transverse d=1 arbitrary-drift iid model.

entries.authors: Sebastian Andres; Alberto Chiarini; Martin Slowik
entries.title: Quenched local limit theorem for random walks among time-dependent ergodic degenerate weights
entries.read_scope: Actual publisher Assumptions1.1–1.2, Theorems1.3–1.4 and general local-CLT criterion; not a full proof read.
entries.comparison: Dynamic symmetric conductance model with inverse-moment assumptions and almost-sure local Gaussian limit. Model equivalence and environmental tail strength required here are absent from that statement.

entries.authors: Carlo Boldrighini; R.A. Minlos; A. Pellegrinotti
entries.title: Central limit theorem for a random walk in dynamical environment: integral and local
entries.read_scope: Author institutional abstract/metadata only. No full text there; official journal/Mathnet attempts failed. Theorem2 is described by DG2022 and BR2023, but their description is not treated as direct reading of this paper.
entries.comparison: Relevant possible older local-corrector antecedent. Its complete estimates and exact reach were not verified directly in this family; this remains an explicit access/priority gap.

entries.title: The almost sure central limit theorem for one-dimensional nearest-neighbour random walks in a space-time random environment
entries.read_scope: Actual Cambridge publisher landing text/abstract only; PDF URL returned article preview rather than full paper.
entries.comparison: Almost-sure CLT for symmetric averaged nearest-neighbor walk at arbitrary disorder strength. No claim is made here about stronger estimates hidden in its unavailable full text.

entries.authors: Sayan Das; Hindy Drillick; Shalin Parekh
entries.title: Multiplicative SHE limit of random walks in space-time random environments
entries.read_scope: Actual publisher abstract, publication/issue dates and references; related theorem comparison in DP2025. Not its full paper.
entries.comparison: Moderate-deviation fluctuation scaling at fixed environment-law variance. Published online2024, issue2026. Its abstract does not assert the all-diverging-block environmental-tail theorem.

entries.title: Hierarchy of KPZ limits arising from directed random walk models in random media
entries.read_scope: Actual selected official full-PDF passages on pp1–11: Assumption1.2, Definition1.4, complete Theorem1.5, Remarks1.6–1.8; pp74–76 §6.1 and Remark6.2; selected proof ending and references. No full87-page proof audit. Screenshot tool yielded reference text without viewable pixels; no visual inspection claimed.
entries.comparison: Moderate-deviation SHE limit in a tempered-distribution/negative-Hölder topology. Remark6.2 explicitly repairs nearest-neighbor parity by two-step kernels on2Z. Main statement does not supply all-diverging-block total variation with superpolynomial environmental tails.

entries.title: An almost sure invariance principle for random walks in a space-time random environment
entries.read_scope: Actual author full-PDF text introduction, space-time model, Hypothesis(ME), complete Theorem1 and its discussion pp1–4; adjacent general Theorem2 read. No full technical-proof audit.
entries.comparison: Covers the fixed iid nearest-neighbor elliptic model at weak invariance-principle level, under more general moment/nondegeneracy assumptions. Its introduction describes BMP2004's earlier fixed-time CLT. Neither a qualitative CLT nor almost-sure convergence alone supplies the candidate's quantifiers.

entries.authors: C. Boldrighini; R.A. Minlos; A. Pellegrinotti
entries.title: Random walks in quenched i.i.d. space-time random environment are always a.s. diffusive
entries.read_scope: Actual publisher abstract, access notice, metadata and references only; full text not available in this family. RAS2005 introduction directly inspected as later primary context, not substituted for the missing2004 full text.
entries.comparison: Relevant general iid-space-time fixed-time CLT antecedent. Its complete internal estimates were not directly checked, leaving an explicit residual priority access gap.
